_comment: Expiring coverage/scenario waivers. Every entry needs reason + owner + expires (ISO date). check_coverage_policy.py fails on missing/expired fields. A waiver is not a permanent exclusion; a `metric: "tier"` entry excuses every floor metric for that module at once.

waivers.reason: Tier 0 floor not yet met: the backend trait / write-buffer / retention paths are tested; the residual is untested error branches and function-count noise from closures in sink/pair_sweeper.
Core migration/recovery/retention/queries have tests; the residual is query-variant branches and monomorphization-deflated function coverage.
SQL construction, row-decode mappings, retention, DDL and writes are covered via a scripted HTTP mock; the residual is live-server row round-trips (it.rs self-skips without a server).
Read-path SPL construction and the retry/auth/concurrency durability machines are covered via a scripted search mock; the residual is HEC write paths and live decode.
Close to target; the residual is uncommon parser/HTTP error branches.
The whole-router smoke covers every endpoint (no 500s); the residual is deep per-route assertions.
Close to target; the residual is platform-specific capture paths.
One metric sits just under the tier-2 floor.
The composition root (pipeline.rs) and CLI subcommands are covered; the residual is the run_pipeline/main.rs path, which needs a real config + capture.
